list.name: store
list.label: Store
list.query: SELECT store_id AS __value, store_name AS __text FROM dim_store ORDER BY 2
list.definition: SELECT store_id AS __value, store_name AS __text FROM dim_store ORDER BY 2

panels.title: On-time rate, last hour
panels.description: On-time orders divided by delivered or breached orders created in the last hour (target 95%).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at - created_at <= promised_minutes * interval '1 minute') / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE (delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at - created_at <= promised_minutes * interval '1 minute') OR ((delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at - created_at > promised_minutes * interval '1 minute') OR (delivered_at IS NULL AND NOT closed_without_delivery AND now() - created_at > promised_minutes * interval '1 minute' + interval '1 minute'))), 0), 1) AS "on time %" FROM live_express_orders WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '1 hour' AND store_id IN ($store)

panels.title: Breaches, last hour
panels.description: Delivered late or overdue (promise plus 1 minute of grace).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "breaches" FROM live_express_orders WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '1 hour' AND store_id IN ($store) AND ((delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at - created_at > promised_minutes * interval '1 minute') OR (delivered_at IS NULL AND NOT closed_without_delivery AND now() - created_at > promised_minutes * interval '1 minute' + interval '1 minute'))

panels.title: At risk now
panels.description: Undelivered orders that used 75% of their promise and are not yet breached.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "orders" FROM live_express_orders WHERE store_id IN ($store) AND delivered_at IS NULL AND NOT closed_without_delivery AND now() - created_at >= promised_minutes * interval '45 seconds' AND now() - created_at <= promised_minutes * interval '1 minute' + interval '1 minute'

panels.title: Open express orders
panels.description: Created, not delivered, not cancelled or returned.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "orders" FROM live_express_orders WHERE store_id IN ($store) AND delivered_at IS NULL AND NOT closed_without_delivery

panels.title: Median delivery time, last hour (min)
panels.description: p50 of delivered orders created in the last hour.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at)) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "minutes" FROM live_express_orders WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '1 hour' AND store_id IN ($store) AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: On-time rate by order creation time (5-minute buckets)
panels.description: Share of resolved orders delivered inside their promise. The dashed line is the 95% target. The live table keeps the last 3 hours of orders.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '5m', 0), round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at - created_at <= promised_minutes * interval '1 minute') / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE (delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at - created_at <= promised_minutes * interval '1 minute') OR ((delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at - created_at > promised_minutes * interval '1 minute') OR (delivered_at IS NULL AND NOT closed_without_delivery AND now() - created_at > promised_minutes * interval '1 minute' + interval '1 minute'))), 0), 1) AS "on time %" FROM live_express_orders WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND store_id IN ($store) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: On-time and breached orders per 5 minutes
panels.description: Orders by SLA outcome, by creation time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '5m', 0), count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at - created_at <= promised_minutes * interval '1 minute') AS "on time", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at - created_at > promised_minutes * interval '1 minute') OR (delivered_at IS NULL AND NOT closed_without_delivery AND now() - created_at > promised_minutes * interval '1 minute' + interval '1 minute')) AS "breached" FROM live_express_orders WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND store_id IN ($store) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Delivery time p50 and p90 (minutes)
panels.description: Delivery time of delivered orders by creation time. Compare with the 20-minute promise.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '5m', 0), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at)) / 60.0) AS "p50", percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at)) / 60.0) AS "p90" FROM live_express_orders WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND store_id IN ($store) AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: SLA by store, last hour
panels.description: Orders, on-time rate, breaches, at-risk orders and p90 delivery time per dark store, worst first.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(s.store_name, o.store_id) AS "store", count(*) AS "orders", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at - created_at <= promised_minutes * interval '1 minute') / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE (delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at - created_at <= promised_minutes * interval '1 minute') OR ((delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at - created_at > promised_minutes * interval '1 minute') OR (delivered_at IS NULL AND NOT closed_without_delivery AND now() - created_at > promised_minutes * interval '1 minute' + interval '1 minute'))), 0), 1) AS "on time %", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at - created_at > promised_minutes * interval '1 minute') OR (delivered_at IS NULL AND NOT closed_without_delivery AND now() - created_at > promised_minutes * interval '1 minute' + interval '1 minute')) AS "breached", count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NULL AND NOT closed_without_delivery AND now() - created_at >= promised_minutes * interval '45 seconds' AND now() - created_at <= promised_minutes * interval '1 minute' + interval '1 minute') AS "at risk", round(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at)) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "p90 min" FROM live_express_orders o LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.created_at >= now() - interval '1 hour' AND o.store_id IN ($store) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 ASC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Open orders closest to their promise
panels.description: Undelivered express orders, oldest first. Act on them before they breach.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(s.store_name, o.store_id) AS "store", o.order_id AS "order", o.promised_minutes AS "promise (min)", round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - o.created_at)) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "age (min)", round((o.promised_minutes - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - o.created_at)) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "minutes left" FROM live_express_orders o LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.store_id IN ($store) AND o.delivered_at IS NULL AND NOT o.closed_without_delivery ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 15

options.content: **On time**: delivered within the order's own promise (`delivered_at - created_at <= promised_minutes`). **Breached**: delivered later than the promise, or still undelivered more than the promise plus a 1-minute grace after it was created (the grace keeps a `delivered` event that reaches the sink a batch late from raising a false alarm). **At risk**: undelivered and at least 75% of the promise has passed (15 minutes for a 20-minute promise), not yet breached. An order that was cancelled or returned without a delivery is **closed without delivery**: it has no delivery to be late, so it is in no count. Times are simulator event times; the state is computed with now(), so it moves between Silver batches. The on-time target is 95%.
